text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Teio Sho was about to begin. Here and 
there in the venue, whispers about Shinko 
Windy could be heard...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
—Shinko Windy sure pulled off a solid win 
in the February Stakes, huh...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
“Still, none of the favorites were in it, 
right? I'm sure she's pretty strong, 
but... naturally, I'm scared of a slip-up, 
so I can't fully back her.”

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
You think so~? Hmm, it really feels like 
she's reflecting on that 'biting 
incident', though...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"A nasty temper like that isn't easily 
fixed~. She hates losing so much she just 
loses her cool, or rather—"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer. Welcome back. How were the 
stands?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I tell her that while there are various 
opinions, many people seem to be paying 
close attention to her in a positive 
light.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Which means... there are still people 
paying attention to me "in a bad way," 
huh~?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, nanoda. Everyone is so 
clueless, nanoda.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Windy-chan is super strong! Super evil! 
But definitely not cowardly!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Even though she's skilled and so cool!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just then, there came a knock at the door. 
The one who arrived was—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yo, came to cheer you on! How're you 
feeling?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Biko! Did you come to watch, nanoda?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, I saw the dirt runners in the 
stands too. Looks like everyone's really 
keeping an eye on Windy-senpai after all."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
By the way, did you see this!? Today's 
sports news update!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the screen presented to me, headlines 
like these danced before my eyes...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"【Surprise Contender?】 Is the "Biting 
Umamusume" Actually a Hidden Powerhouse!? 
~A Look Back at the Spring Dirt G1 
Season~"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
The headline's a bit catchy, sure, but the 
article actually said some really nice 
things. I'm sure you'll be happy once you 
read it!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Oho oho? Well, I'll read it once I'm free, 
then♪

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Heheh... Looks like the public's startin' 
to see me in a new light too. The wind's 
blowin' in my favor...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
So, come on, so... Make sure you nail it 
right here!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"I'll be cheering you on with a 
'Full-Charge Carotene!', too!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
That goes without saying! I'll show them 
what I'm made of today too...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'll plunge the entire venue into the 
absolute depths of terror!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We're all fired up! The Teio Sho is about 
to begin—!
